blocks.title: Deploy with a single manifest.
blocks.bodyHtml: Describe your application in CUE: kind: Application, declare dependencies through needs.pg / needs.redis / needs.disk. Deploy via CLI or through an AI agent over MCP — destructive operations gated by a CRD, no kubectl delete surprises. The platform handles the rest — managed Postgres, Redis instances, persistent disks. No 400-line values.yaml. No drift between dev and prod.

blocks.title: From one VDS to production, no scaling ceiling.
blocks.bodyHtml: The same manifest runs on a €5 Hetzner VDS today (single node, Tier 1) and is designed to scale horizontally to an HA cluster of any size and node mix (Tier 2, Phase 3). When you grow, you'll add nodes — you don't migrate to a different platform when you hit your provider's vertical ceiling. No rewriting applications between dev and prod.

blocks.title: Open source, no vendor lock-in.
blocks.bodyHtml: FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0, auto-converts to Apache 2.0 in two years. Everything runs on your hardware or in your cloud. The managed version is on the way for those who'd rather not run ops themselves. And when you want back to self-host from it — there'll be a CLI command for that. Not a philosophy, an architecture.
